- **Open the concept layer with Concept Journey** · Concept Constellation, Symbolic Atlas, Philosophy Atlas, Politics, AI Act
  Follow one concept at a time through stories, philosophy, Riksdag speeches and the AI Act; the constellation stays as the exploring view.
- **Record why the system changes in an append-only Idea Lineage journal** · Portfolio
  Ideas, decisions, experiments, findings and questions are stored as short structured events; prompts and conversations never are.

## Decisions
- **Keep all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for the published atlas** · Symbolic Atlas

## Experiments
- **Four embedding models compared by their nearest neighbours** · Symbolic Atlas
  MiniLM, bge-base, e5-base and gte-base on the same 21,898 book-centred passages, scored by the share of each passage's 10 nearest neighbours from the same book or with the same symbol.

## Findings
- **Larger models gained about four points on same-symbol neighbours** · Symbolic Atlas
  gte-base put 31 % same-symbol passages among the neighbours against 26 % for MiniLM; same-book neighbours fell from 26 % to 22-25 %.
